//: Static-analysis config only. Runtime behaviour is unaffected by this file.
//venv: Without this, pyright falls back to whatever `python` is on PATH (here: Homebrew 3.14) and reports false 'could not be resolved' for every first-party and third-party import. The project venv is 3.13.9 and contains the editable install of autofde_lab/skdecide plus every extra from `uv sync --extra=all`.
//extraPaths: Belt-and-braces for the src/ layout: makes `autofde_lab.*` and `skdecide.*` resolve from the working tree even in a checkout where the editable install has not been made yet.
//exclude: Vendored gyms, build output, and scratch run dirs are not this repo's code to type-check.
//typeCheckingMode: `basic`, deliberately not `strict`: the repo has substantial pre-existing type looseness and strict mode would bury real diagnostics under thousands of annotation-style findings. Import resolution is checked at full strength below.
//reportMissing: Kept at error so a genuinely missing dependency is still surfaced -- this config fixes false import errors, it does not suppress the class.
//reportMissingTypeStubs: Many runtime deps here (ray, rdflib plugins, gymnasium ecosystem) ship no stubs; that is not a defect in this repo.
